title: Tactical command
idea: Tactical command: Selected unit abilities and turn consequence flank the map
audience: People who need to plan turn within a game surface.
worksWellWhen: Deliberate turn choices have meaningful costs
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic tactical layout through its plan turn priority and explicit commitment contract: Preview cost and confirm turn commitment
navigation: Tactical command keeps the current plan turn context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Selected unit abilities and turn consequence flank the map

imagery.role: Support the actual plan turn context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Support controller focus and touch selection equivalently
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the tactical command structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no plan turn content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Preview cost and confirm turn commitment
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized plan turn content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Preview cost and confirm turn commitment
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active plan turn context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.
